reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin centered on visualizing context-window token usage, compression status, and estimated costs through a /context command and persistent floating card.

summaries.zh: 通过 /context 命令和可拖动悬浮卡，以图表展示 DeepSeek Harness 的上下文 token 使用情况、压缩效果与估算费用。
summaries.en: Visualizes DeepSeek Harness context token usage, compression effects, and estimated costs through a /context command and a draggable floating card.

capabilities: Displays current context token usage and allocation in charts and progress indicators
Shows estimated session costs using configurable per-route and per-model pricing
Provides a floating status card with draggable and collapsible controls
Triggers the host application's /compact command from the floating card
